title: First-Peer Profit-Memory Checkpoint

selection_card.central_question: At the strict first natural exit of another portfolio position, does a still-held target that remains profitable differ materially and broadly from one that has already surrendered all prior positive mark, both in final stressed outcome and in the path that remains after the checkpoint?
selection_card.why_now: The verified research-observation ledger is the first frozen Next artifact to record the held target's current mark, prior peak and later close at the exact first-peer natural-exit checkpoint. Strict outcome-free topology is balanced at 60 versus 61 eligible targets across five strategies and both natural symbols. This new data role has more decision value than forcing an unready Program 2 source or reopening recent Program 1, 3, 5 or 7 work.
selection_card.connection_bridge: Unit 020 found actual Live profit-memory loss reversals but retained a late-maturity guard, while Unit 021 closed invalid without an economic verdict. Unit 052 classified held targets only by the peer's exit type and had no causal mark state at that moment. Unit 057 uses a newly available frozen Lab checkpoint to ask a different question: whether the target still holds profit or has already given it back when the first peer naturally exits, and whether the future path then diverges.
selection_card.decision_if_true: Retain one later, independently named multi-period entry-preserving observation question for the passing checkpoint state. Do not select a close, breakeven, trail, stop, threshold, EA or Live action in Unit 057.
selection_card.decision_if_false: Do not spend a multi-period MQL or real-tick matrix on first-peer profit-memory treatment; preserve native position management and rotate across the whole map.
selection_card.not_adjacent_or_random: This is not another peer-exit-type split, not the close-time 0.125R reversal test, and not a study opened merely because a logger was just built. The exact checkpoint state did not exist in prior evidence, the two eligible roles are balanced, and the result changes whether a broader management observation is worth building.
automatic_followups_forbidden: profit threshold, giveback threshold or peak-fraction grid
peer identity, direction, count or same-symbol split
elapsed-time window, weekday, session or period rescue
close, breakeven, trail, stop, partial-close or cohort rule
lot, slot, priority, admission or entry suppression

fixed_checkpoint_reconstruction.records: Use exactly BIRTH, FIRST_PEER_NATURAL_EXIT and CLOSE rows from the immutable lifecycle ledger and preserve record_id as the row identity.
fixed_checkpoint_reconstruction.link: Link one FIRST_PEER_NATURAL_EXIT row to exactly one later CLOSE row by exact position_identifier.
fixed_checkpoint_reconstruction.strict_order: The target CLOSE server_time must be strictly later than the checkpoint server_time. Same-second checkpoint and close rows are context-only and excluded.
fixed_checkpoint_reconstruction.checkpoint_state_only: Assign the role using only FIRST_PEER_NATURAL_EXIT last_mark_r and peak_mark_r before any linked CLOSE economic field is cast.
fixed_checkpoint_reconstruction.PRIOR_PROFIT_GIVEN_BACK: checkpoint peak_mark_r is strictly positive and last_mark_r is nonpositive.
fixed_checkpoint_reconstruction.passive_exclusion: Passive has only one strict PROFIT_STILL_HELD row and is context-only.

future_outcomes.final_stressed_r: linked CLOSE stressed_net_usd divided by positive planned_risk_usd
future_outcomes.stop: linked CLOSE exit_class denotes a stop exit rather than native exit
future_outcomes.remaining_stressed_r: final_stressed_r minus checkpoint last_mark_r; this is a conservative state-to-final change descriptor, not an executable hypothetical close P/L
future_outcomes.post_checkpoint_new_high: linked CLOSE peak_mark_r exceeds checkpoint peak_mark_r by more than 1e-12
future_outcomes.additional_peak_r: maximum of zero and linked CLOSE peak_mark_r minus checkpoint peak_mark_r

fixed_checkpoint_reconstruction.benchmark: For each eligible strategy, compute the PRIOR_PROFIT_GIVEN_BACK mean for final stressed R, stop, remaining stressed R, post-checkpoint new-high and additional peak R.
fixed_checkpoint_reconstruction.treatment_residual: For each PROFIT_STILL_HELD target, subtract its exact strategy comparator mean for each metric.

pre_outcome_feasibility.scope: Only file identity, row/event identity, position_identifier, server-time order, component, symbol, planned-risk validity, partial flag and checkpoint last/peak mark fields were used. Linked CLOSE actual_net_usd, stressed_net_usd, exit_class, peak path and every Unit 057 economic metric remain unopened.

predeclaration_execution_disclosure.authoritative_display: the final strict classification reported above

fixed_reports.role_context: For all strict roles report n, checkpoint mark R, checkpoint peak R and checkpoint giveback R by pooled, strategy and symbol views.
fixed_reports.future_outcome: For both eligible roles report final stressed R, stop rate, positive rate, remaining stressed R, post-checkpoint new-high rate and additional peak R by pooled, eligible-strategy and symbol views.
fixed_reports.residual: For PROFIT_STILL_HELD report equal-target pooled strategy-adjusted residuals for all five future metrics, eligible-strategy raw differences, symbol residual means and absolute final-R contribution shares.
fixed_reports.context_only: Report NEVER_POSITIVE, same-time and Passive only as counts and descriptive context; they cannot enter a gate or rescue.

fixed_bundle_gate.nonpassing_action: Retain no first-peer profit-memory seed and do not build a broader observer matrix.
